title: グローバルPD
subtitle: Global PD
courseType:
Practical Engineering Education Program
Practical Engineering Education Courses
keywords: Social Innovation 2.Cross-cultural, Multi-disciplinary collaboration 3.Project-based teamwork 4.Global cooperation 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Global PD is a service-learning design course in which teams of students from across the world work together on 2 weeks projects that benefit the community. Students use the Design Thinking methodology to co-create innovative solutions to real-life issues. Through this project, students should be able to apply their teamwork and communication skills, develop a better understanding of themselves, fostering empathy for the community, and realize the positive impact for the community in need.
advice: In Global PD, students will learn and experience: [Multidisciplinary Design] - Learn how to be better designers, gain design knowledge and skills. - Learn how to identify and acquire new knowledge - Learn to collaborate with people from other disciplines and develop an appreciation for cross-disciplinary contributions in design. [Professional Preparation] - Develop a broad set of skills needed to be successful in the changing global societies [Service-Learning] - Provide significant service to the community while learning - Gain an understanding of the role that engineering and their discipline can play in society
requiredKnowledge: In Global PD, students are encouraged to work together and share information under multi-disciplinary, cross-cultural settings. Since, we expect every student to practice honorable, ethical, and professional behavior both inside and outside the classroom.

activityGoals.body: Student should be able to collaborate with persons who have a multi-disciplinary and cross-cultural backgrounds
Student should be able to use the design thinking methodology to co-create innovative solutions to real issues
Students should be able to express their ideas and concepts using prototypes
Students should be able to work on a global team
Students should be able to manage their health, safety, and security overseas
Students should be able to share their outcomes with stakeholders

achievementLevels.ideal: After the completion of this course, students will be able to - understand of design as a start-to-finish process - use an ability to identify and acquire new knowledge as a part of the problem-solving/design process in community-based projects - foster an ability to function on multidisciplinary teams and an appreciation for the contributions from individuals from multiple disciplines - get an ability to communicate effectively both orally and written with widely-varying backgrounds - find an appreciation of the role that their discipline can play in social contexts
achievementLevels.standard: After the completion of this course, students will be able to - understand of design as a start-to-finish process - use an ability to identify and acquire new knowledge as a part of the problem-solving/design process in community-based projects - get an ability to communicate effectively

lessons.content: [Pre-fieldwork training #1] - Basic of Design Thinking methodology
lessons.assignments: Prepare a presentation materials for discussion.

lessons.content: [Pre-fieldwork training #2] - Basic of health, safety, and security management in a foreign country

[Fieldwork in ASEAN country] Day 1: Moving day Day 2- 3, Sense and Sensibility - prepare for joining the project - Design Thinking recap Day 4-6, Empathy - Homestay - Complete observations and interviews - Define the project goal Day 7-9, Ideation/Prototyping - Create concepts for the project goals - Prepare presentation materials and prototypes to share your ideas/concepts Day 10, Co-creation - Share your ideas/concepts with stakeholders - Obtain feedback from stakeholders Day 11, Improving prototypes - Improve your concepts/prototypes using the feedback Day 12, Gallary walk presentation - Share your findings/ideas/concepts at a local university Day 13, Cultural Immersion - Visit cultural facilities to learn the local culture Day 14, Moving day
lessons.operation: Lecture, Exercise, Presentation, and cultural interaction
lessons.assignments: Assignments will be provided through the program.
Prepare and complete your visual portfolio

lessons.content: [Post-fieldwork activities #2] - Prepare for final presentation - Complete your final presentation and discussion
[Reflection] - Submit your log-book - Summarize what you did through the project.
lessons.assignments: Summarize your activities, behaviors, and outcomes from Global PD
